subject: Jeffery Simmons
headline: The Bears Paid Two First-Round Picks for Jeffery Simmons and a Shot at a Title
title: Bears Land Jeffery Simmons in a Blockbuster Titans Trade
subheadline: Chicago sent its 2027 and 2028 first-round picks to Tennessee for the All-Pro defensive tackle, betting that a 5-2 start can become something bigger.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: The 5-2 Bears traded two first-round picks to Tennessee for All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, adding an elite interior rusher before Monday in Seattle.
searchIntent: Fans who heard about the trade want to know what Chicago gave up, what Simmons brings and when he could debut, with a path to Bears jerseys.
body: Teams with a 5-2 record usually make small moves at the trade deadline. The Chicago Bears made one of the biggest of the season instead, and Jeffery Simmons is the reason.

Chicago agreed on Oct. 29 to acquire the [All-Pro defensive tackle](/players/jeffery-simmons/) from the Tennessee Titans, pending a physical. The Titans receive the Bears' first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 plus a 2027 fourth-rounder. Chicago also gets a 2028 fifth-round pick back in the deal.
## What Chicago is getting

Simmons has spent his whole career in Tennessee since the Titans took him in the first round of the 2019 draft. He made four Pro Bowls there, served as a team captain five times and earned his first All-Pro selection in 2025.

He has been just as disruptive this season. Entering Week 8, he led all defensive tackles with 28 pressures, according to NFL.com. He also led the position in pressures and sacks when facing double teams, with 10 and three, and was tied for second among tackles with 21 run stops.
The Bears also take on a big contract. Simmons signed a three-year, $105.8 million extension with Tennessee in June, with $100 million guaranteed.
## Why the Bears went for it

Chicago's defensive front already had veteran Grady Jarrett, and edge rusher Montez Sweat is back from a two-game suspension. What the line lacked was a star who can collapse the pocket from the middle. Simmons fills that role, and he frees up the edge rushers around him.
For a team with [Caleb Williams](/players/caleb-williams/) at quarterback and a winning record, the message is clear: the Bears believe their window is open now, not in two years.
## A big first test

The timing makes the move even more interesting. Chicago plays the defending champion Seattle Seahawks on Monday night, Nov. 2, at Lumen Field. If Simmons is cleared to play, the national audience gets an early look at how he changes the Bears' defense.

subject: Pete Crow-Armstrong
headline: Pete Crow-Armstrong's Peers Just Named Him Baseball's Best Player
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong Wins Players Choice Player of the Year
subheadline: The Cubs center fielder took the MLBPA's top honor and NL Outstanding Player after a 45-homer, 41-steal season, with more awards still to come.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Cubs center fielder Pete Crow-Armstrong won Players Choice Player of the Year and NL Outstanding Player after leading MLB with 45 home runs and 119 runs.
primaryKeyword: Players Choice Player of the Year
searchIntent: Fans who saw the award news want to know what Crow-Armstrong won and why, and what other honors could follow, with a path to his jersey.
body: Awards voted on by writers carry weight. An award voted on by the players who tried to get Pete Crow-Armstrong out all season says something different.

On Oct. 28, the MLB Players Association named the [Cubs center fielder](/players/pete-crow-armstrong/) its 2026 Player of the Year and the National League's Outstanding Player in the Players Choice Awards.
## The season that earned it
Crow-Armstrong led the majors with 45 home runs and 119 runs scored. He also stole 41 bases and drove in 107 runs while hitting .280 with a .372 on-base percentage and a .570 slugging percentage.
Topping 40 homers and 40 steals in the same year put him in rare company. It was only the seventh 40-40 season in MLB history, and it rewrote a large part of the Cubs' franchise record book.

That production came from a player whose glove was his calling card when he arrived in the majors. He remains one of the game's best defensive center fielders, which is why the season's value went beyond the batter's box.
## Strong company

The other headline winners show how strong the season was. Houston's Yordan Álvarez won AL Outstanding Player after leading the American League in batting average, on-base percentage and slugging. Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski, fresh off a World Series title, was named NL Outstanding Pitcher after leading the majors with a 1.80 ERA. The Yankees' Cam Schlittler took the AL pitching award.
## More hardware could follow

Award season is just getting started. Crow-Armstrong is a Gold Glove finalist, with winners revealed on Nov. 1, and a Hank Aaron Award finalist. He is widely viewed as the favorite for NL MVP, which will be announced on Nov. 12.

Fans can see how he compares with the league's biggest stars on our [top selling MLB jerseys](/top-selling-mlb-jerseys/) page. If the next two weeks go the way his season did, his trophy shelf is about to get crowded.
